neighbours.label: A one-letter Arabic or Hebrew prefix split off as its own token in mid-sentence: the article ال (Hebrew ה), 'and' و, or 'to' ل, cut from a longer or less common word the tokenizer does not keep whole. Quiet when the article stays merged into a short common word, at the very start of a text, and in English; sometimes also on '(' glued between an English UI word and its Korean translation.
neighbours.short: split-off Arabic/Hebrew one-letter prefix (ال, و, ل, ה)
neighbours.notes: Cold step-in (labelled from own tops and probes only). Reader of bonsai1/L34/N11316- (downstream drop 0.04); the label has little to do with the feeder's coined-phrase repeats. Test sentences written blind by a second author who saw only the label; the solver placed two bank lines (one scored ~0.01 in probing) as fire items.
